procedure.method: Independent fresh critic assessment. Read only the user-pinned inputs; SHA-256 and byte lengths matched, and PNG IHDR dimensions matched all nine view pins and the three native manifests. source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so there was no separate source asset or protected-layout manifest to inspect. Opened and visually inspected each exact PNG through tools.view_image with detail:'original', displaying each returned image via functions.exec, in this order: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine displayed views were inspected before the first transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. Then preserved all 21 first raw native-view copy readings. A genuine M1 date-dash/spacing ambiguity triggered one further open of the same pinned M1 native PNG; both reads and the resolution are retained. viewed_count=9 counts the nine required distinct views, not the ambiguity revisit. No runtime/thread identity is observable here; session_id is null. No embedded manifest path, peer review or author interpretation was used.
procedure.protected_layouts_note: Packet supplies no protected layouts or protected-layout measurement manifests.
